dct_description_sm: Within Nevada County, the Community Regions are established as the areas of the County within which growth should be directed to provide compact, areas of development where such development can be served most efficiently and effectively with necessary urban services and facilities. (Refer to Nevada County General Plan, Land Use, Policy 1.2 )
